notifications.title: Notifications 🔔
notifications.description: Get a notification on the day of the event (and optionally a reminder a few days before) at the chosen time (Home Assistant local time).

data.persistent: Also create a Home Assistant persistent notification

data_description.targets: One or more notify.* services (e.g. notify.mobile_app_my_phone). You can also type a name.
data_description.time: Default 09:00. If Home Assistant restarts after this time on the day, the notification is sent once at startup.
data_description.reminder_days: Example: 7 to be warned one week before. 0 disables the reminder.
data_description.persistent: Also shows the message in Home Assistant notifications.
